title: Calculator
invariant: Reject invalid inputs and division by zero without evaluating arbitrary expressions.

title: Todo with undo
invariant: Undo restores the original id and position.

title: Quiz
invariant: One answer per question contributes at most one score.

title: Weather app
invariant: Old responses cannot replace the latest requested location.

title: Local notes
invariant: Titles render as data rather than executable markup.

title: Expense tracker
invariant: Store positive safe integer cents and compute totals from all relevant records.

title: Blog
invariant: Only authorized authors can modify their drafts or publications.

title: Movie catalog
invariant: Detail and favorite state refer to stable movie ids, not array positions.

title: Video catalog interface
invariant: Playback failures and missing captions remain visible; do not redistribute unlicensed media.

title: E-commerce frontend
invariant: Client totals are presentation; final stock and price must be revalidated by a server.

title: Admin dashboard
invariant: A visible admin screen never substitutes for server permissions.

title: Kanban board
invariant: Two writes using the same stored version cannot both succeed.

title: Chat application
invariant: Room membership is checked server-side and durable messages have stable ids.

title: Full MERN e-commerce
invariant: No negative stock or duplicate paid business effect after replay.

title: Learning management system
invariant: Enrollment and progress writes are scoped to the permitted account and course.

title: Job portal
invariant: One applicant/job pair has one active application; employers see only permitted submissions.

title: Social network
invariant: Feed and media access respect visibility and ownership, including after cache invalidation.

title: Project management platform
invariant: Every operation validates tenant membership and persisted task version.

title: Recoverable real-time chat
invariant: Reconnect and duplicate delivery do not lose or repeat a durable message in the view.

title: Expense management platform
invariant: Money and owner scope remain correct across list truncation, concurrent approval, and replay.
